plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Music Performance, Bachelor of Music (BM) graduation plan text PDF. The plan carries the catalog note 'Some aspects of this plan vary depending on which performance track a student pursues. Please consult with an advisor.' Semester totals as printed: 15 / 16 / 16 / 14 / 15 / 16 / 14 / 13 = 119, matching the printed 'Total Hours 119'. Source anomaly documented: the 4th-Year Spring row 'MUSC 4840R - 4851R Private Lessons' is printed with no credit hours, and the printed semester total (13) and program total (119) reconcile only if that slot contributes 0 credits — it is modeled as a 0-credit required_zero slot rather than inventing hours. Course titles verified against the official 2025-2026 BM program text PDF: MUSC 1000R Concert Attendance; MUSC 1001 First Year Experience: Music; MUSC 1050 Introduction to World Music (FA); MUSC 1110 Music Theory I; MUSC 1120 Music Theory II; MUSC 1130 Ear Training & Sight Singing I; MUSC 1140 Ear Training/Sight Singing II; MUSC 2110 Music Theory III; MUSC 2120 Music Theory IV; MUSC 2130 Ear Training/Sight Singing III; MUSC 2140 Ear Training/Sight Singing IV; MUSC 2180 Introduction to Music Technology; MUSC 2350 Fundamentals of Conducting; MUSC 3540 Form and Analysis; MUSC 3630 Music History & Literature I; MUSC 3640 Music History & Literature II; MUSC 3650 Music History and Literature III; MUSC 3890 Junior Recital; MUSC 4890 Senior Recital; MUSC 3222 Choral Conducting / MUSC 3380 Instrumental Conducting; ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). MUSC 1000R (Concert Attendance, 0 credits) is required every semester in years 1-2, hence allow_repeated_courses with this documented repeat. 'MUSC xxxxR - xxxxR Private Lessons' ranges, 'Music Track Emphasis', 'Elective Credits', 'General Elective', and GE slots are choice placeholders — see the 2025-2026 catalog course descriptions. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
